id.tagline: Sambung kata bareng teman, cepat & seru!
id.heroSub: Kata berikutnya harus nyambung dari huruf atau suku kata terakhir. Ada batas waktu tiap giliran — pikir cepat, ketik, kirim!
id.name: Nama kamu
id.practiceSub: Main sendiri lawan bot, tanpa server.
id.onlineOff: Main online hanya bisa di lanjutkata.jadidaring.com. Mode latihan vs bot tetap bisa dimainkan di sini.
id.onlineDisabled: Server online sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi nanti, atau main latihan dulu.
id.onlineReady: Online siap! Buat room, gabung kode, atau cari match publik.
how: Host memilih mode: Huruf terakhir atau Suku kata terakhir, timer, jumlah giliran (3 / 5 / 7 / 10 atau ∞ Tak terbatas), dan bahasa kata.
Permainan dimulai dari satu kata acak. Di gilirannya, tiap pemain mengetik kata yang nyambung lalu tekan Kirim.

Kamus ketat: kata harus ada di kamus bahasa yang dipilih (Campuran = kamus Indonesia atau Inggris), minimal 3 huruf, huruf saja, dan belum dipakai. Kata karangan ditolak — coba lagi selama waktu masih ada (kecuali host memilih “salah = giliran lewat”).
Waktu habis atau Lewati = 0 poin dan giliran pindah. Kalau semua pemain berturut-turut buntu, muncul kata baru.
Giliran terbatas: setelah tiap pemain dapat giliran sebanyak yang dipilih host, skor tertinggi menang!

∞ Tak terbatas: tidak ada batas giliran. Waktu habis, Lewati, atau salah kata (mode giliran lewat) = gugur. Yang bertahan paling akhir menang. Kalau kata di kamus sudah habis untuk rantai itu, permainan selesai dan yang masih bertahan diurutkan dari skor.
id.modeHurufDesc: makan → nasi → ikan… Kata baru mulai dari huruf terakhir.
id.modeSukuDesc: ma-kan → kan-cil → cil… (lebih dari 3 huruf dipotong jadi 3, mis. ma-ngan → nga).
id.sukuNote: Suku kata dihitung otomatis dari kelompok huruf vokal (a, i, u, e, o). Satu konsonan di antara vokal ikut suku berikutnya (ma-kan), dua konsonan dibagi (lam-pu), kecuali ng / ny / kh / sy / tr / pr / bl… yang tetap bareng (ba-ngun). Kalau awalan terlalu sulit, aturannya dilonggarkan otomatis supaya tidak buntu.
scoring: Poin dasar = panjang kata (maks 15) — hanya kata di kamus yang diterima
+2 kilat kalau dijawab di 40% waktu pertama
id.why_plaus: Hmm, itu bukan kata di kamus 🤔
id.errFull: Room penuh atau sudah mulai — kamu menonton dulu 👁
id.footerNote: Game gratis di browser. Tanpa akun, tanpa top-up.
id.turnsInfNote: ∞ Tak terbatas: waktu habis / Lewati / salah = gugur. Bertahan paling akhir menang!
id.habis: Kata habis! Tidak ada lagi kata di kamus untuk melanjutkan rantai.

en.tagline: Chain words with friends, fast & fun!
en.heroTitle: Chain the words, chase the score!
en.heroSub: Your word must continue from the last letter or the last syllable. Every turn has a timer — think fast, type, send!
en.name: Your name
en.practiceSub: Play alone against bots, no server needed.
en.onlineOff: Online play only works on lanjutkata.jadidaring.com. Practice vs bots still works here.
en.onlineDisabled: The online server is unavailable right now. Try again later, or practice first.
en.onlineReady: Online ready! Create a room, join a code, or find a public match.
how: The host picks the mode: Last letter or Last syllable, the timer, the number of turns (3 / 5 / 7 / 10 or ∞ Unlimited) and the word language.
The game starts from a random word. On your turn, type a word that continues the chain and tap Send.

Strict dictionary: the word must be in the dictionary of the chosen language (Mixed = Indonesian or English list), 3+ letters, letters only, and not used yet. Made-up words are rejected — try again while time remains (unless the host chose “wrong = turn passes”).
Time out or Skip = 0 points and the turn passes. If everyone gets stuck in a row, a fresh word appears.
Limited turns: when every player has had the chosen number of turns, the highest score wins!

∞ Unlimited: no turn limit. Time out, Skip or a wrong word (turn-passes mode) = you're out. The last player standing wins. If the dictionary runs out of words for the chain, the game ends and the players still in are ranked by score.
en.modeHurufDesc: lemon → nose → eagle… Start with the last letter.
en.modeSukuDesc: wa-ter → ter-ri-ble → ble… (longer than 3 letters is cut to 3, e.g. make → mak).
en.sukuNote: Syllables are found automatically from vowel groups (a, e, i, o, u, y). One consonant between vowels joins the next syllable (ma-kan), two are split (lam-pu), except ng / ny / ch / sh / th / tr / pl / st… which stay together (ba-ngun). A silent final “e” is not a syllable (make). If a prefix is too hard, it is relaxed automatically so the chain never gets stuck.
scoring: Base points = word length (max 15) — only dictionary words are accepted
+2 quick bonus in the first 40% of the timer
Time out / skip = 0 (∞ mode: you're out)
en.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start…
en.why_plaus: Hmm, that is not a dictionary word 🤔
en.waitRematch: Waiting for the host to play again…
en.errFull: Room is full or already playing — you are watching 👁
en.footerNote: Free browser game. No account, no top-up.
en.turnsInfNote: ∞ Unlimited: time out / Skip / wrong word = out. Last player standing wins!
en.habis: Out of words! No dictionary word can continue the chain.
